data.TITLE: My Tiny Helper Band
data.SUBTITLE: Make this for someone you care about.
data.INSTRUCTION_2B: Or write who you want to help.
data.INSTRUCTION_4: Join the ends and wear it
data.BAND_TEXT: I CAN BE A TINY HELPER
data.WISDOM_TEXT: Small steps can make a big difference.
data.CLUE_TEXT: Try one kind action today, even if it feels tiny.
data.FOOTER_SMALL: Wear your band as a reminder.

data.TITLE: My Helpful Words Band
data.SUBTITLE: Wear this when you want to keep the words that help you grow.
data.INSTRUCTION_4: Join the ends and wear it
data.WISDOM_TEXT: Listen like a winnowing basket and keep the words that help you grow.
data.CLUE_TEXT: Ask: Does this help me grow, or is it only noise?
data.FOOTER_PROMPT: Which words will you keep today?
data.FOOTER_SMALL: Let the noisy words fall away.

data.TITLE: My Growing Heart Band
data.SUBTITLE: Make this when you want to grow with gratitude through muddy days.
data.INSTRUCTION_4: Join the ends and wear it
data.WISDOM_TEXT: A lotus grows beautifully even through muddy water.
data.CLUE_TEXT: Notice one small sign that you are growing today.
data.FOOTER_PROMPT: What are you grateful for today?
data.FOOTER_SMALL: Wear your band and remember your growing heart.
